blueprint.summary:
Blueprint for PR2 (the salesperson flow) in /Users/joegallant/AI App Development Projects/Dealer-Social-Post-AI, on branch design/streamlined-flow from main at 75c4140. I read the approved spec, all six artboards, the Light Table spec and its guard test, the five-area audit, and the code. Five findings shape the plan.

(1) Most of what the store needs already exists on the dealer record: facebook_page_tag, signature_look + alternate_look (two Looks), category_destinations (channels and video per category), feature_permissions (video, playful, freeTextEdit), playful_style, motion_signature, requires_approval, the employee_disclosure_* fields, and custom_scenarios. But services/creativeSystem.ts only applies them when creative_system_v2 is true, and that flag is off by default. The new flow needs one pure resolver, services/storeDefaults.ts. For v2 dealers it passes resolveCreative through unchanged; for everyone else it falls back to sensible values. PR3 then only adds default channels, a list of offered Looks, and Playful per category.

(2) The behaviour that must survive is inlined in two very large files. PostResult.tsx (5,688 lines) holds the locks, approval polling, release repair, autosave with its compare-and-set revision, the Customer Hub handoff, per-destination file preparation, video jobs and the share-caption pack. PostCustomizer.tsx holds the brief composition and the pre-generation guards. These must be pulled out, with no change in behaviour, before any new screen can use them.

(3) services/publishTargets.ts already separates preparePublishShare (async, done before the tap) from sharePrepared (calls navigator.share before its first await). The new Share button can therefore open the OS share sheet in one tap with no dialog, as long as the file is prepared when the channel is selected.

(4) Two things do not exist yet. Nothing records "Shared to Facebook" on a post, so PR2 needs an additive PocketBase 0.22 field and an owner-scoped route. Generation progress is faked with timers, so useGeneration needs real stages and a Cancel.

(5) The saved session stores the step as a number, and the e2e suite seeds step:4. The AppStep enum is renamed with explicit numeric values kept (HOME=1, DETAILS=2, CREATING=3, POST=4) and WORK=7 added. Old hashes stay as read-only aliases.

I recommend amending the proposed two-PR split to three: PR2-0 for the extractions and the backend share record, with no visible change and the existing unit tests unchanged as proof; then PR2a (front half) and PR2b (back half) as proposed. There are 22 units in total: 11 design (Opus) and 11 mechanical (Sonnet).

pr_split.name: PR2-0 — extractions and share record (no visible change)
pr_split.scope: Move the behaviour-carrying logic out of PostCustomizer.tsx, PostResult.tsx, CameraCapture.tsx, PostHistory.tsx, LocalMediaArchive.tsx and RecentCaptureShelf.tsx into services and hooks that the old screens then consume. Add the share-events field, route and client helper on the backend. Add real generation stages and Cancel to useGeneration, while the old overlay still reads the legacy progress values.
pr_split.rationale: This amends the proposal. PostResult is 5.7k lines of closures sharing refs (currentPostPropRef, latestWebsiteCreativeRef, lastPostRevisionRef). If the extraction ships alone, the existing 58 PostResult and 35 PostCustomizer tests, left unchanged, prove nothing moved. Mixed into PR2a or PR2b, a regression cannot be traced to either the extraction or the redesign. Only source-guard tests that pin a moved string are retargeted, in the same commit. The backend share endpoint lands a release before any frontend calls it, which fits the known Fly-before-Vercel deploy-order trap: the endpoint is additive and nothing old depends on it.

pr_split.name: PR2a — shell, step machine, Home, Details, Creating
pr_split.scope: New AppStep machine and URL sync. A store draft slice. services/storeDefaults.ts. Home.tsx with the tiles, native camera or file picker, walkaround tile and My work preview. PostDetails.tsx with one signature sheet, VIN sheet in manual mode first, the optional line, and a gated Create post. The rewritten Creating overlay with honest stages and Cancel. Delete CameraCapture, WebcamCapture, ImageCropModal, PostCustomizer, ScenarioPicker, ProgressSteps and templates. Keep the old PostResult as the Post screen for one release, reached as AppStep.POST. RecentCaptureShelf moves into the existing My work modal so recovery stays reachable.
pr_split.rationale: Validated as proposed. The front half is what counts most toward the tap target (capture, the review modal and the 40-control details form go away). It can ship behind the unchanged PostResult because generation still produces the same GeneratedPost and delivery plan. For legacy dealers the channels now come from storeDefaults instead of the picker, and PostResult already renders any platformIds list. Changes that would break e2e are limited to the capture test and two heading pins.

pr_split.name: PR2b — Post, Shared, My work, deletions
pr_split.scope: PostScreen.tsx: preview card, channel chips, Look chips, inline caption editing, Try another, Add video and Playful per the store's allowed options, one lock banner, Share opening the OS sheet, Shared state and Done. hooks/usePostShare.ts and hooks/usePostCreativeTools.ts. MyWork.tsx as a real step (#/work) with statuses and the device recovery grid. Discard guard only for an unsaved post. Delete PostResult and everything only it uses. Retarget the remaining source guards. Rewrite the result and website e2e cases.
pr_split.rationale: Validated as proposed. Post, Shared and My work share the new share and share-record plumbing and the leave guard, so they belong together. Deleting PostResult in the same PR as its replacement avoids two live publish surfaces. Every behaviour PostResult carried has already been extracted in PR2-0, so the deletions are mechanical.

blueprint.step_machine:
The AppStep enum keeps its numeric values, because saved sessions and e2e seeds store the number. Values: LOGIN=0, HOME=1 (was CAPTURE), DETAILS=2 (was CUSTOMIZE), CREATING=3 (was GENERATING), POST=4 (was RESULT), ADMIN=5, DEALER_ADMIN=6, WORK=7 (new).

Hashes: HOME #/home, DETAILS #/details, POST #/post, WORK #/work, ADMIN #/admin, DEALER_ADMIN #/dealership, LOGIN #/login. CREATING maps to #/details, so it never creates a history entry of its own. Read-only aliases on popstate and boot: #/capture goes to HOME, #/customize and #/generating go to DETAILS, #/result goes to POST. On boot the URL is normalized with replaceState.

Transitions:
- LOGIN goes to HOME for salespeople (stepForRole). Managers and system admins still land on their dashboards; starting a post from there is PR3.
- HOME: a tile tap opens the camera or file picker. On a file, handlePhotoPicked archives the original, sets selectedImage and postDraft {categoryId, scenarioId}, and goes to DETAILS (push #/details). There is no review modal.
- HOME: a desktop drop or a recovery reuse sets pendingPhoto and shows 'Pick what this photo is for'. A tile then goes straight to DETAILS.
- HOME: 'See all', or My work in the header, goes to WORK (push #/work).
- DETAILS: Back or Escape goes to HOME, which starts a new post and clears generationParams, postDraft and pendingRelease.
- DETAILS: Create post runs buildGenerationRequest then handleGenerate. The mutation's onMutate sets CREATING with no URL change.
- CREATING is a step, not a local state, because it owns the screen and must survive the Back guard and a reload. On a reload it restores to DETAILS. On success it sets generatedPost and goes to POST (push #/post). On an identity or claims failure, or a provider error, it goes to DETAILS with store.error, and the error banner offers Try again. Cancel calls cancelGeneration and goes to DETAILS with no error. Popstate during CREATING is refused and the URL restored.
- Retry and remix seed Details from the store, not from local component state. postDraft (category, scenario, decodedVehicle, personalLine) is persisted with the session. The captured release (pendingRelease, including releaseId once saved) is kept in memory only. generationParams stays persisted as today. So Cancel, an error, Back from POST (a remix) and Back from DETAILS after an error all remount Details with the same values and nothing retyped. startRemix clears generatedPost (the post itself remains in My work) and goes to DETAILS.
- POST: canLeavePost is true when generatedPost.postId exists or a share has been recorded. When true, Back goes to DETAILS as a remix if selectedImage exists, otherwise to WORK. When false, the URL is restored and a 'Discard this post?' dialog opens. Done after a share calls reset and goes to HOME (push #/home). Logout asks for confirmation only when canLeavePost is false.
- A post reopened from history goes WORK, then openCreative, then setSelectedImage(null), setGenerationParams(null), setGeneratedPost(toGeneratedPostFromRecord(record)) with historyReadOnly for a teammate's post, then POST (push #/post). POST renders read-only: no edit tools, and delivery only when the locks allow it. Back goes to WORK.
- WORK: Back goes to HOME.
- Role gates on ADMIN and DEALER_ADMIN are unchanged. The URL never signs anyone in or out.
- Restore rules: step 4 with a complete post restores to POST. Steps 2, 3 or 4 with only a photo restore to DETAILS. Step 7 restores to WORK. Anything else goes to HOME.
blueprint.data_flow:
1. Home. HOME_TILES and resolveStoreDefaults(dealer, person, category) supply the tiles and the per-category rules. A tile tap calls input.click() synchronously on a hidden file input. usePhotoIntake.processFile(file) returns an ImageSelection {workingImage: EXIF-normalized 2048 px JPEG data URL, originalSource: File}. useAppController.handlePhotoPicked archives the original with archiveDealerMedia(kind 'capture', no names), then calls store.setSelectedImage (IndexedDB plus session), store.setPostDraft({categoryId, scenarioId}) and setStep(DETAILS). My work preview uses usePostHistoryList({limit:3}) and postStatusFor(record).

2. Details. It reads postDraft, pendingRelease and resolveStoreDefaults. The signature sheet's onCaptured stores {customerName (legal), signaturePngDataUrl, vin} as pendingRelease, in memory only. The public label is toPublicCustomerLabel(release.customerName). The VIN sheet (VinScanner, manual mode first when there is no BarcodeDetector) writes decodedVehicle to postDraft; a changed VIN clears pendingRelease. The personal line goes to postDraft. Website readiness comes from listWebsiteDestinations.

3. Create post. buildGenerationRequest({dealer, person, scenarioId, publicName, capturedRelease: pendingRelease, decodedVehicle, personalLine, platformIds: defaults.generationPlatformIds, outputProfile: defaults.primaryProfile, websiteEnabled: defaults.websiteChannel, mediaOutputMode 'photo', fallback style and tone from the default Look}). It gives either a gate reason, shown on Create post, or the args for useGeneration.handleGenerate, which keeps its current signature. Inside handleGenerate: resolveCreative reconciles again, then onMutate sets CREATING. The stage becomes 'signature' and runWithPersistedPhotoRelease saves the release before any provider call. The stage becomes 'design', with image and caption running in parallel and partsReady fed by onPartReady. The stage becomes 'checks': the customer-identity guard, prepareCaptionForDelivery (disclosures kept outside the caption), the caption pack and the website draft. The stage becomes 'saving': logPost, which submits for approval when required, then linkReleaseToPostWithRetry. Finally setGeneratedPost(finalPost) and setStep(POST).

4. Post. Each part comes from one module:
- approval state from useApprovalStatus(post)
- release state from useReleaseRepair(post)
- locks and the one banner from derivePostLocks, fed by buildShareCaptions (identity and claims re-scanned per channel)
- the delivery plan from usePreparedDelivery(post, selectedChannel), through derivePlatformDeliveryPlan and renderFormatIfNeeded (validateVideoMetadata for video)
- caption edits from the inline textarea: the guards re-run on blur, then useDraftAutosave debounces 600 ms and calls updatePostDraft, returning post_revision
- the share itself from usePostShare, which runs preparePublishShare(targetId, {text: body, disclosures, requiredPrefix: employeeDisclosure, preparedFile}) before the tap
- the Share tap calls sharePrepared synchronously: navigator.share first, clipboard in parallel. On a 'shared' result, recordPostShared(postId, {destinationId, via}) goes to POST /api/app/posts/:id/shared, which appends to share_events, and generatedPost.sharedTo is updated in the store and saved with the session.
- Try another, Look, Add video and Playful from usePostCreativeTools, backed by useGeneration's regenerate and fun-mode mutations and useVideoJobs; results are cached per Look and the budget is persisted on the post.
- the website send from useWebsiteHandoff: flush the draft, get the revision, onPrepareFinalWebsiteDraft, then enqueueWebsitePublication(postId, draft, expectedRevision).

5. Shared and Done. canLeavePost is now true. reset() goes to HOME and clears the draft and pendingRelease.

6. My work. usePostHistoryList calls listPostsPage, which projects share_events, approval_status and rejection_reason; postStatusFor sets each row's status. Tapping a row calls openCreative: fetchPostCreativeDataUrl, then toGeneratedPostFromRecord, then POST. The 'On this device' section uses useDeviceMedia over creativeStorage, with save via mediaSave and a confirmed delete.

Server-owned data untouched: photo releases, posts (plus share_events), the approval routes and website publications. Client-only data: the local media archive and the in-memory signature.

critique.notes:
The plan needs revision: I found 5 high gaps and 5 sequencing problems.

High:
- **Release reused across posts.** The plan keeps and reuses releaseId after the release is linked to a post, which the server rejects with a 409. The retry or remix then stays release-locked and the customer has to sign again.
- **Consent text narrowed.** The new wording drops the advertising scope and the right to withdraw consent. This needs legal sign-off, not just restyling.
- **Release gate no longer fails closed.** An unknown or missing scenario used to default to one that requires a release; the plan does not keep that default.
- **Leave guard loses its busy checks.** Leaving no longer waits for a running website send or image/text update, and no longer protects paid video jobs or edits whose autosave failed.
- **Stale post not cleared on a new photo.** handlePhotoPicked does not clear generatedPost or the error. Forward to #/post can then regenerate the old post from the new customer's photo.

The Pro/PR split and the extraction-first idea are sound.

All findings come from reading the code, the audit and the e2e specs. I ran nothing: no tests and no servers. The main files are components/PostResult.tsx, components/PostCustomizer.tsx, hooks/useGeneration.ts, hooks/useAppController.ts, services/photoReleases.ts, services/publishTargets.ts, pb_hooks/main.pb.js, utils/persistence.ts and e2e/flow.spec.ts.
